name: claudepet
description: A desktop companion for Windows that lets you chat with Claude from anywhere.

scripts.build: node scripts/vendor.js && tsc && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/main/bounds.test.js dist/main/settings.test.js dist/main/chats.test.js dist/main/bridge.test.js dist/main/links.test.js dist/renderer/scroll.test.js dist/renderer/markdown.test.js dist/renderer/codeBlocks.test.js
